summary:
医疗AI周报（据输入条目）

研究进展
- OUD-REY基于All of Us纵向电子病历预测一年内阿片使用障碍风险，内部验证AUROC 91.2%、AUPRC 77.0%，并在All of Us时间外部队列与约600万VA患者中外部验证[1]。
- 一项回顾性开发并外部测试的深度学习模型，用同日胸片-超声配对数据识别胸片上的左心室射血分数降低，外部测试含三级中心与体检队列，以AUC/AUPRC评估并估算经胸超声心动图减负[2]。
- 系统综述与荟萃分析纳入46篇报告、41个独立队列（含40个核心队列），发现正确自动建议下临床医生判断准确性显著更高（合并OR 10.19）；四项真实心电图研究中26.6%的错误解读未被识别或纠正[3]。
- EEG基础模型MORGOTH经多中心开发与验证，报告达专家级脑电解读表现；低资源场景准确性提升、高流量中心效率提高[4]。
- 丹麦多中心阶梯楔形整群随机对照试验显示，实施计算机辅助质量反馈系统提高腺瘤检出率、息肉检出率与腺瘤检出相关指标，并延长退镜时间；未报告癌症结局[5]。
- 环境AI书记员纵向准实验研究覆盖36家诊所220名基层医生、31.4万余次就诊，采用中断时间序列前后各150天，结局含记录时长、非工作时间、笔记长度与wRVU[7]。
- 国际多中心回顾性研究显示，持续学习可在不共享数据的情况下将成人气管插管评估模型适配到新生儿胸片；覆盖20个国家30个NICU、每院50张胸片，持续学习定位误差0.67厘米，医院专属模型1.29厘米[8]。
- 新生儿气腹人机协同诊断多读者交叉研究完成1750次判读，高可靠AI使受训者更易受自动化偏差影响，受训者接受52.0%的错误建议；专家正确否决91.7%错误建议，但仅3人[9]。
- 患者门户消息分阶段部署研究对比AI草稿展示组21073条与未展示组45127条，2264条（11%）草稿被采纳，BERTScore F1为0.93；BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore等自动指标与医生盲评的相关性随情境变化[10]。
- TRAM-AI基于33名国际专家两轮改良Delphi制定14项医学影像AI数据集透明报告清单，并在10个公开数据集试点验证，含拉美与撒哈拉以南非洲区域适用性评估[11]。
- HPV初筛后双染分流AI模型开展独立外部验证，目标是缩小人工判读缺口；条目未列性能数据[12]。
- 多中心开发、外部验证与独立测试的可解释多模态AI模型用于预测TAVI术后长期死亡风险，报告性能显著优于传统风险评分，并称跨不同TAVI人群与临床场景泛化良好[13]。
- 单中心回顾性研究纳入509例连续检查，用多智能体大模型联合CNN自动完成治疗后胶质瘤MRI的BT-RADS分级；gpt-oss提取器智能体从病历抽取临床变量，评分智能体结合决策逻辑与定量体积测量，以专家标注为参考标准[15]。
- 多中心外部验证显示，成人活检训练的AI模型可泛化至儿童乳糜泻诊断，跨中心与扫描平台表现良好，概率输出校准，可辅助排除阴性活检[16]。
- JAMIA研究在1000份MIMIC-IV出院小结上比较单智能体、自反思单智能体与多智能体抽取-复核三种架构，用四个开源大模型提取DNR/DNI/CMO；金标准由医师与AI双人复核裁定，κ为0.98–0.99[17]。
- 方法学与影像基础模型方面：脓毒症自动病例检测系统综述按患者/入院/ICU住院划分分析单元，揭示6个维度方法学异质性与可复现性问题[21]；医学图像分析性能不确定性大规模研究以置信区间为对象，属评测方法学工作[22]；AMIFound统一七种医学成像模态的复原与增强，声称保留诊断相关临床信息[23]；UPER提出多维度扩散MRI统一多面体表示，仅见题录[34]。
- 挑战赛与评测方面：CXR-LT 2026聚焦多中心长尾分布与零样本胸片分类[18]；SICS-155挑战赛推动白内障手术阶段自动识别[24]；SEG.A 2023综述主动脉血管树自动分割与建模挑战赛及多团队方案[42]。
- 基于2.95亿条2019–2024年住院EHR审计日志，研究用符号与语义两种编码微调Llama-3-8B建模临床医生与电子病历交互流程序列，并以马尔可夫模型为最小上下文基线[25]。
- JAMIA随机对照实验纳入220名临床医生，比较无透明度、数值置信度与叙述性解释三种条件，均未显著影响工具信任或总体信任；任何AI辅助后信心平均提升约6.7%[26]。
- 单中心回顾性队列分析39.1万次成人门诊就诊，用双重差分法估计AI scribe可用性与患者指导文书记录频率的关联，并对比AI独写、AI辅助与医生独写的可读性[29]。
- 结构化AI标准化病人研究对五个前沿LLM生成的350次模拟问诊做盲法专家评估，学员水平对表现差异的解释力高于模型选择（η² 0.31 vs 0.06）；155次真实学生问诊分析发现遗漏安全关键信息的系统性问题[30]。
- 癫痫管理机器学习系统综述与meta分析指出，样本小、缺失数据处理与外部验证稀缺等异质性和偏倚限制临床可用性，建议扩大数据集、标准化最低报告并开展前瞻试验[31]。
- 回顾性对比研究显示，大数据微调时传统深度学习模型与视网膜专用基础模型RETFound在眼病检测上性能相近；小数据微调时RETFound在全身疾病检测上占优[32]。
- Noise2Match提出利用相邻CT切片相似性并处理非刚性错位的自监督低剂量CT去噪方法，无需配对干净数据；条目指出经典自监督法假设噪声像素独立，不适用于LDCT[39]。
- EyeGraph提出结合知识图谱推理的眼科视觉语言模型，并发布多粒度眼科VQA数据集IT-Retinal，采用两阶段训练加知识图谱推理以抑制幻觉，任务覆盖多粒度视觉问答（仅据摘要）[41]。
- 神经肿瘤患者报告结局AI叙述性综述检索2015–2026年英文文献，纳入53篇文献进行主题综述，讨论AI分析PRO的应用与伦理[48]。
- 预印本PRET提出无需示例训练的全癌种少样本病理识别系统，在23个国际基准、4484张全切片图像上评测，20项任务优于现有方法、15项AUC超97%，称部分任务最高提升36.76%[49]。

落地监管
- SCPMG提出C-TACT临床AI治理框架，含人员、流程、技术三支柱，覆盖供应商评估、试点、规模化、维护四阶段，并使用加权评分卡；示例性回顾中试点评分卡区分两组部署[27]。
- NEJM AI刊文总结50余个算法在2000家医院、约1100万患者中的临床AI开发与落地经验，聚焦从开发到实际使用的障碍[28]。
- 一项将GPT-4o实时集成进电子病历识别安宁疗护目标照护文档的实践，在四家医院试点六个月后全院推广；以专家裁定为参考标准，特异度0.95、召回0.74；325份AI标记病历人工审计一致率86%[35]。
- NEJM AI发表基于Cleveland Clinic AI峰会的临床AI跨卫生系统规模化框架[19]。
- NEJM AI刊文提出从技术表现走向临床就绪的分阶段临床AI证据标准框架；仅见题录，未见正文[50]。

产业动态
- Coreline Soft的AVIEW Aorta Metrics获美国FDA 510(k)许可，扩展其胸部CT AI产品线[38]。

限制与待核实
- 人工监督相关证据提示风险：四项真实心电图研究中26.6%的AI错误解读未被识别或纠正[3]；受训者接受52.0%的错误建议，专家正确否决91.7%错误但仅3人[9]；三种透明度条件对临床医生信任均无显著影响[26]。
- AI临床消息研究中，BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore等自动指标与医生盲评的相关性依赖情境，不能据单一自动指标直接推断临床可接受性[10]。
- 丹麦结肠镜计算机辅助质量反馈试验未报告癌症结局，相关临床结局待核实[5]。
- 脓毒症自动病例检测存在方法学异质性与可复现性问题[21]；医学图像性能不确定性研究提示置信区间评测属方法学问题[22]；癫痫管理机器学习证据受样本小、缺失数据处理与外部验证稀缺限制[31]。
- PRET为预印本，需待同行评审与独立验证[49]。
- 对话式脑部AI用于自适应癫痫照护仅为研究亮点介绍的小规模研究，未披露样本与量化结果，且点评指出更大挑战是让AI做出恰当回应[43]。
- 仅见标题/题录、未见样本量、结果或全文的研究包括：问诊前AI文档摘要RCT[6]、AI辅助听诊识别左心室功能不全前瞻性多中心外部验证[14]、AI临床文书效率纵向研究[20]、RACR-MIL全切片弱监督鳞状细胞癌分级[36]、保留临床判断述评[37]、个性化AI心理健康支持文化背景[40]等，相关结论待核实。
- HPV双染分流AI条目未列性能数据[12]；TAVI多模态AI条目未列具体指标[13]；上述结果细节待核实。

items.title: A generalizable deep learning model for predicting opioid use disorder using language modeling for cross-EHR data harmonization
items.zh_title: 跨EHR语言建模的阿片使用障碍泛化预测模型
items.summary: OUD-REY基于All of Us纵向电子病历预测一年内阿片使用障碍风险，并在VA等外部队列验证。
items.abstract: The opioid use disorder (OUD) epidemic in the United States has been a major public health crisis. We developed OUD-REY (OUD Risk Evaluator at 1 Year) - a deep learning model that uses longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data from the All of Us research program to predict risk of OUD at one year for patients with an opioid prescription. On internal validation, OUD-REY achieved an AUROC of 91.2% and AUPRC of 77.0%. We leveraged a pretrained language model to accommodate thousands of unseen, out-of-vocabulary clinical features in a patient’s longitudinal EHR history. We externally validated our model on a new dataset released by All of Us that was temporally separated from our development set and on a dataset containing ~6 million patients from medical centers of the Veterans Affairs (VA) nationwide over a span of 20 years. On external validation, our model had an AUROC and AUPRC of 86.4% and 23.1% (OUD prevalence of 2.9%), respectively, on our temporally separated All of Us validation set. It had an AUROC and AUPRC of 85.5% and 19.5% (OUD prevalence of 3.5%), respectively, on the VA dataset. Our fairness auditing showed that the model was generally fair for patients with different genders, race, and ethnic backgrounds. This model may potentially improve prevention and care of OUD.

items.zh_abstract: 美国的阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）流行一直是一场重大公共卫生危机。我们开发了OUD-REY（OUD风险一年评估器，OUD Risk Evaluator at 1 Year）——一种深度学习模型，利用“All of Us”研究项目的纵向电子健康记录（EHR）数据，预测接受阿片类药物处方的患者一年时发生OUD的风险。在内部验证中，OUD-REY的AUROC达到91.2%，AUPRC达到77.0%。我们利用预训练语言模型来处理患者纵向EHR病史中数千个未见的、词汇表外的临床特征。我们在All of Us发布的一个与开发集时间分离的新数据集上，以及在一个包含来自美国退伍军人事务部（VA）全国医疗中心约600万患者、跨度20年的数据集上，对我们的模型进行了外部验证。在外部验证中，我们的模型在时间分离的All of Us验证集上的AUROC和AUPRC分别为86.4%和23.1%（OUD患病率2.9%）。在VA数据集上，其AUROC和AUPRC分别为85.5%和19.5%（OUD患病率3.5%）。我们的公平性审计显示，该模型对不同性别、种族和族裔背景的患者总体公平。该模型可能有望改善OUD的预防和照护。

items.abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Purpose To develop and evaluate a deep learning model (DLLV) for identifying reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) on chest radiographs (CXRs) and assess its potential as a prescreening tool for selective transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) in health checkup populations. Materials and Methods Same-day CXR-TTE pairs obtained between January 2016 and September 2021 were retrospectively collected for model development. Counterfactual learning was applied to enhance model performance and interpretability. External testing included one tertiary referral center cohort and two health checkup cohorts. Discrimination was evaluated using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC), and DLLV-based prescreening was evaluated by estimated TTE reduction and missed-case burden. Results The development dataset included 24,674 patients (32,135 CXR-TTE pairs); external cohorts included 5440, 28,034, and 6085 patients (53-62% male). DLLV achieved an AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.84, 0.88) for LVEF ≤ 40% in the tertiary referral cohort. In health checkup cohorts, AUCs were 0.92-0.97 for LVEF ≤ 40%, with AUPRCs of 0.04 in both cohorts, corresponding to 87-fold (95% CI: 16, 404) and 37-fold (95% CI: 3, 251) enrichment over baseline prevalence. Counterfactual reinforcement learning produced heatmaps with greater heart localization precision (P < .001 for all) and higher AUC for LVEF < 50% (P = .04). DLLV-based prescreening estimated TTE volume reductions up to 85% while identifying all 12 and 7 individuals with LVEF ≤ 40%. Conclusion DLLV identified reduced LVEF on CXRs across external test cohorts and showed potential as a prescreening tool for selective TTE in health checkup populations. ©RSNA, 2026.
items.zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并评估一种用于在胸部X线摄影（CXRs）上识别左心室射血分数（LVEF）降低的深度学习模型（DLLV），并评估其在健康体检人群中作为选择性经胸超声心动图（TTE）预筛工具的潜力。【材料与方法】回顾性收集2016年1月至2021年9月期间获得的同日CXR-TTE配对数据用于模型开发。应用反事实学习以提高模型性能和可解释性。外部测试包括一个三级转诊中心队列和两个健康体检队列。使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）评估区分能力，并通过估计的TTE减少量和漏诊病例负担评估基于DLLV的预筛。【结果】开发数据集包括24,674例患者（32,135对CXR-TTE配对）；外部队列分别包括5440、28,034和6085例患者（男性占53–62%）。在三级转诊队列中，DLLV对LVEF ≤ 40%达到AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.84，0.88）。在健康体检队列中，对LVEF ≤ 40%的AUC为0.92–0.97，两个队列的AUPRC均为0.04，分别相当于较基线患病率富集87倍（95% CI：16，404）和37倍（95% CI：3，251）。反事实强化学习生成的热图具有更高的心脏定位精度（所有P < .001），并且对LVEF < 50%具有更高的AUC（P = .04）。基于DLLV的预筛估计可使TTE检查量减少最多85%，同时识别出全部12例和7例LVEF ≤ 40%的个体。【结论】DLLV在外部测试队列中识别出CXRs上的LVEF降低，并显示出作为健康体检人群中选择性TTE预筛工具的潜力。©RSNA, 2026。

items.zh_title: 临床AI错误输出的人工监督：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summary: 荟萃46篇报告发现，正确自动建议下临床医生判断准确性显著更高，部分真实场景中AI错误解读未被纠正。
key_points: 46篇报告、41个独立队列，含40个核心队列
正确建议下医生正确率显著更高（合并OR 10.19）
四项真实心电图研究中26.6%错误解读未被识别或纠正
items.reason: 荟萃分析样本量大且结论明确，涉及AI安全与人工监督，属重要档
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports clinical decisions, but human oversight is protective only if clinicians recognize and resist erroneous output. We systematically reviewed controlled and real-world studies of clinician responses to incorrect automated advice. Forty-six reports represented 41 independent cohort clusters, including 40 core cohorts. Across three adjusted cohorts, clinician correctness was substantially higher with correct than incorrect automated advice (pooled OR 10.19, 95% CI 7.43–13.98; I² = 0%); a ≥ 2020 sensitivity analysis was similar but imprecise (OR 9.22, 95% CI 2.06–41.13). In four heterogeneous real-world computerized ECG studies, 26.6% of erroneous interpretations were not corrected or recognized (95% CI 6.4–65.6%; I² = 95.8%). Contemporary AI and large language model studies also documented harmful reliance but were too heterogeneous for pooling. Patient-level adverse events were reported in one retrospective cohort. Human oversight should be evaluated as an error-interception capability rather than assumed to ensure safety.
items.zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）越来越多地支持临床决策，但只有当临床医生识别并抵制错误输出时，人工监督才具有保护作用。我们系统综述了关于临床医生对不正确自动化建议反应的对照研究和真实世界研究。46篇报告代表41个独立队列集群，包括40个核心队列。在三个校正队列中，临床医生在正确自动化建议下的正确性显著高于不正确自动化建议（合并OR 10.19，95% CI 7.43–13.98；I² = 0%）；≥2020年的敏感性分析结果相似但不精确（OR 9.22，95% CI 2.06–41.13）。在四项异质性真实世界计算机化心电图研究中，26.6%的错误解释未被纠正或识别（95% CI 6.4–65.6%；I² = 95.8%）。当代AI和大语言模型研究也记录到有害依赖，但异质性过大而无法合并。一项回顾性队列报告了患者层面的不良事件。人工监督应作为错误拦截能力进行评估，而不是假定其能确保安全。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To investigate the longitudinal effects of an ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribe use in primary care on outcomes related to documentation time, note writing patterns, and clinician financial productivity. We conducted a quasi-experimental study with an interrupted time-series design to ascertain the effect of AI scribe use on note writing time, time outside of scheduled hours (TOSH), pajama time (5:30PM-7:00aM), note length, note closure <24 h, and work relative value units (wRVU). For each primary care clinician (physician, advanced practice provider), date of initial access was day 0; each measure was calculated for 150 days prior (pre-period) and after (post-period) day zero. Two hundred and twenty clinicians (mean age = 43.7, 70.9% females; 56.4% physicians) from 36 clinics, conducting 314 845 patient encounters were included. Compared to the pre-period, there was 7% decrease in note writing time at day 0 (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 0.93, 95% credible interval [CI] [0.89, 0.98]), increasing to 16% decrease by day 150 (IRR 0.84, 95% CI [0.82, 0.87]). There was no change in pajama time, TOSH, or wRVU at day 0; however, at day 150, there was a 19% decrease in pajama time (0.81, 95% CI [0.73, 0.90]), 13% decrease in TOSH (0.87, 95% CI [0.77, 0.98]), and a 2% increase in wRVU (1.02, 95% CI [1.01, 1.04]). At day 0, there was a 5% increase in note closures (1.05, 95% CI [1.02, 1.08]), with no difference to pre-period levels by day 150. There were no changes in note length at day 0 or day 150. There were persistent changes in AI scribe use measures over time as clinicians situated these tools within their workflows.

items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 旨在探究在初级保健中使用环境人工智能（AI）scribe（记录助手）对文书工作时间、记录书写模式和临床医生财务生产力相关结局的纵向影响。我们开展了一项采用中断时间序列设计的准实验研究，以确定AI scribe使用对记录书写时间、计划外时间（time outside of scheduled hours，TOSH）、睡衣时间（下午5:30至上午7:00）、记录长度、记录在<24小时内关闭以及工作相对价值单位（wRVU）的影响。对于每位初级保健临床医生（医生、高级执业提供者），首次访问日期为第0天；每项指标均计算第0天前150天（前时段）和后150天（后时段）。纳入来自36家诊所的220名临床医生（平均年龄=43.7，女性70.9%；医生56.4%），共进行314 845次患者就诊。与前时段相比，第0天记录书写时间下降7%（发生率比[IRR] 0.93，95%可信区间[CI] [0.89, 0.98]），到第150天增至下降16%（IRR 0.84，95% CI [0.82, 0.87]）。第0天睡衣时间、TOSH或wRVU无变化；然而，到第150天，睡衣时间下降19%（0.81，95% CI [0.73, 0.90]），TOSH下降13%（0.87，95% CI [0.77, 0.98]），wRVU增加2%（1.02，95% CI [1.01, 1.04]）。第0天记录关闭增加5%（1.05，95% CI [1.02, 1.08]），到第150天与前时段水平无差异。第0天或第150天记录长度均无变化。随着临床医生将这些工具融入其工作流程，AI scribe使用指标随时间出现持续变化。

items.abstract: Despite growing clinical adoption of artificial intelligence in radiology, fewer than one in five commercially available models are cleared for paediatric use. Existing systems are trained predominantly on adult data and generalize poorly to neonates, yet efficient strategies for repurposing them without data sharing or large-scale local data curation are lacking. Here we present an international retrospective study of neonatal chest radiographs from 30 neonatal intensive care units across 20 countries and territories, evaluating continual learning as a privacy-preserving approach to adapt a deep learning model for adult endotracheal tube assessment to neonatal care. Each hospital contributed 50 radiographs for sequential model retraining without centralized data pooling. Continual learning achieved lower anatomical landmark localization error (0.67 cm versus 1.29 cm for hospital-specific fine-tuning and 4.30 cm for adult-only models) at 29 of 30 sites, with improved detection of deep intubations at 27 of 30 sites. These findings demonstrate that privacy-preserving collaborative learning can address critical gaps in paediatric AI deployment.
items.zh_abstract: 尽管人工智能在放射学中的临床采用日益增多，但市售模型中获准用于儿科使用的不足五分之一。现有系统主要基于成人数据训练，对新生儿的泛化能力较差，然而缺乏在不共享数据或不大规模本地数据整理的情况下对其进行再利用的有效策略。在此，我们介绍一项国际回顾性研究，研究对象为来自20个国家和地区30个新生儿重症监护病房的新生儿胸部X线片，评估持续学习（continual learning）作为一种隐私保护方法，将用于成人气管插管评估的深度学习模型适配至新生儿护理。每家医院贡献50张X线片用于序贯模型再训练，而无需集中式数据汇集。持续学习在30个站点中的29个实现了更低的解剖标志定位误差（0.67 cm，对比医院特定微调的1.29 cm和仅成人模型的4.30 cm），并在30个站点中的27个改善了深部插管的检测。这些发现表明，隐私保护协作学习可以解决儿科人工智能部署中的关键差距。

items.abstract: Medical AI is often validated under an additive assumption that algorithmic sensitivity and clinician oversight will combine to improve care. We tested this assumption in the high-stakes diagnosis of neonatal pneumoperitoneum, a time-critical surgical emergency. In a multi-reader crossover study analyzing 1750 interpretation events, clinicians reviewed radiographs aided by either a high-reliability model or a systematically error-injected model. We found that high AI reliability paradoxically induces automation bias in trainees, who accepted 52.0% of incorrect suggestions, while offering limited gains to experts. Conversely, when challenged by flawed AI, the three participating neonatologists exhibited a “sentinel behavior” phenotype, correctly overriding 91.7% of errors (Wilson 95% CI: 83.0–96.0%) consistent with increased deliberation; given the small specialist cohort, this finding is hypothesis-generating and warrants prospective replication. We operationalize systemic resilience as the capacity to maintain diagnostic integrity under algorithmic failure and demonstrate that clinical validity depends on the human–AI team’s adversarial resilience rather than standalone accuracy. To mitigate the risk of deskilling and never-skilling, we release an open-source educational sandbox designed to inoculate clinicians against automated errors.
items.zh_abstract: 医学AI通常是在一种加性假设下进行验证的，即算法敏感性与临床医生监督将结合起来改善诊疗。我们在新生儿气腹这一时间关键的外科急症的高风险诊断中检验了这一假设。在一项分析了1750次判读事件的多阅片者交叉研究中，临床医生在一种高可靠性模型或一种系统性错误注入模型的辅助下审阅X线片。我们发现，高AI可靠性反而会在受训者中诱发自动化偏差（automation bias），他们接受了52.0%的错误建议，而对专家带来的增益有限。相反，当受到有缺陷AI的挑战时，三名参与的新生儿专科医生表现出“哨兵行为”（sentinel behavior）表型，正确否决了91.7%的错误（Wilson 95% CI：83.0–96.0%），这与更审慎的思考增加相一致；鉴于专科医生队列较小，该发现具有产生假设的性质，值得前瞻性重复验证。我们将系统韧性操作化为在算法失败时维持诊断完整性的能力，并证明临床有效性取决于人类–AI团队的对抗韧性，而非单独准确性。为降低技能退化与技能从未形成的风险，我们发布了一个开源教育沙盒，旨在使临床医生对自动化错误产生免疫。

items.abstract: Abstract Evaluation of AI-generated patient communication lacks standardized frameworks, and automated metrics may not reflect clinical utility. We leveraged a staged rollout of GPT-generated draft responses (GDRs) to patient portal messages. Thirty primary care physicians received drafts from September 2023 to August 2024 under two conditions: an intervention group where AI drafts were displayed and edited ( n = 21,073), and a non-displayed group where drafts were generated but never shown to physicians, who composed responses independently ( n = 45,127). We evaluated messages using BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and Flesch Reading Ease, and then correlated automated metrics with blinded physician ratings of effectiveness, misunderstanding potential, and harm. In the intervention group, 2264 (11%) drafts were incorporated into final messages with high semantic alignment (BERTScore F1 = 0.93). In the non-displayed group, independent physician messages showed moderate similarity to unseen drafts (BERTScore F1 = 0.83). Despite comparable semantic scores, physicians preferred human-authored messages (4.24/5). BERTScore correlated with physician quality ratings in the intervention group but not in the non-displayed. Automated metrics demonstrated context-dependent validity; they assessed editing fidelity but failed to evaluate whether AI-generated content matches independent human performance. Rigorous evaluation of clinical generative AI requires validation of metric meaning within specific use contexts.
items.zh_abstract: 对 AI 生成的患者沟通进行评估缺乏标准化框架，自动化指标可能无法反映临床效用。我们利用 GPT 生成的草稿回复（GDRs）在患者门户消息中的分阶段推广。30 名基层医生在 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 8 月期间在两种条件下接收草稿：干预组显示并编辑 AI 草稿（n = 21,073），非显示组生成草稿但从未向医生展示，医生独立撰写回复（n = 45,127）。我们使用 BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore 和 Flesch Reading Ease 评估消息，然后将自动化指标与盲法医生对有效性、误解可能性和危害的评分进行相关性分析。在干预组中，2264 份（11%）草稿被纳入最终消息，且语义一致性高（BERTScore F1 = 0.93）。在非显示组中，医生独立撰写的消息与未显示的草稿显示出中等相似性（BERTScore F1 = 0.83）。尽管语义得分相当，医生更偏好人类撰写的消息（4.24/5）。BERTScore 在干预组中与医生质量评分相关，但在非显示组中不相关。自动化指标表现出依赖情境的有效性；它们评估了编辑保真度，但未能评估 AI 生成内容是否与独立的人类表现相匹配。对临床生成式 AI 的严格评估需要在特定使用情境中验证指标含义。

items.abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Purpose To develop and evaluate TRAM-AI, a consensus-based checklist for verifying whether medical imaging datasets described as publicly accessible are functionally usable for AI development. Materials and Methods A modified Delphi study was conducted. A steering committee generated candidate checklist items through a targeted literature review. An international expert panel (n = 33) rated items on criticality and feasibility across two Delphi rounds. Consensus was defined as ≥ 75% agreement on both dimensions. The checklist was pilot-validated in 10 publicly available datasets. An advisory group of four experts from Latin America and sub-Saharan Africa evaluated cross-regional applicability. Results Of 16 candidate items, 14 were retained in the final checklist; one item was removed because of feasibility concerns, and another was merged with an existing item because of conceptual redundancy. All 14 final items achieved consensus for both criticality and feasibility. The final TRAM-AI checklist comprises 14 items across four domains: Dataset Access and Persistence (3 items), Technical Interoperability (4 items), Metadata and Reproducibility (4 items), and Ethical, Legal, and Maintenance considerations (3 items). In pilot validation, all items were applicable to all 10 datasets, compliance was 90% for trusted repository, de-dentification, and subject-level mapping, 10% for archive validation, and 30% for partition keys. All four advisory group members endorsed the checklist. Conclusion TRAM-AI provides a practical framework for verifying the functional accessibility of medical imaging datasets, complementing existing methodological reporting standards. Further evaluation and broader validation across diverse geographic settings are warranted. ©RSNA, 2026.

Artificial intelligence]【目的】开发并评估 TRAM-AI，一种基于共识的清单，用于核验被描述为可公开获取的医学影像数据集在功能上是否可用于人工智能（AI）开发。【材料与方法】开展了一项改良德尔菲研究。指导委员会通过定向文献综述生成候选清单条目。一个国际专家小组（n = 33）在两轮德尔菲中对条目的关键性和可行性进行评分。共识定义为两个维度均达到≥75%同意。该清单在10个公开可用数据集中进行了试点验证。由来自拉丁美洲和撒哈拉以南非洲的四名专家组成的顾问组评估了跨区域适用性。【结果】在16个候选条目中，14个被保留在最终清单中；1个条目因可行性担忧被删除，另1个条目因概念冗余与现有条目合并。所有14个最终条目在关键性和可行性两方面均达成共识。最终的 TRAM-AI 清单包含4个领域的14个条目：数据集获取与持久性（Dataset Access and Persistence，3个条目）、技术互操作性（Technical Interoperability，4个条目）、元数据与可重复性（Metadata and Reproducibility，4个条目），以及伦理、法律与维护考量（Ethical, Legal, and Maintenance considerations，3个条目）。在试点验证中，所有条目均适用于全部10个数据集；可信存储库、去标识化（de-dentification）和受试者层面映射的符合率为90%，归档验证为10%，分区键为30%。顾问组全部四名成员均认可该清单。【结论】TRAM-AI 提供了一个实用框架，用于核验医学影像数据集的功能可及性，补充现有方法学报告标准。有必要在不同地理环境中进一步评估和更广泛验证。©RSNA, 2026。

items.abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] The Brain Tumor Reporting and Data System (BT-RADS) standardizes posttreatment MRI response assessment in patients with diffuse gliomas but requires complex integration of imaging trends, medication effects, and radiation timing. An end-to-end multiagent large language model and convolutional neural network system for automated BTRADS classification was developed and evaluated. Five hundred nine consecutive posttreatment glioma MRI examinations (March 2017-July 2021) from a single center were retrospectively evaluated. An extractor agent identified clinical variables from notes using gpt-oss (OpenAI, 20-billion parameters). A scorer agent applied BTRADS decision logic integrating these with quantitative volumetrics. System accuracy was compared against initial assessments, using expert annotation as the reference standard. Four hundred ninety-two examinations were evaluable. Overall system accuracy was 76.0% (374/492) versus 57.5% (283/492) for initial assessments, an absolute difference of +18.5 percentage points (P < .001). Cohen kappa between the system and the reference standard was 0.71. The system achieved high sensitivity in context-dependent categories (BT-1b; 100%; BT-1a, 92.7%; BT-3a, 87.5%) and moderate sensitivity for threshold-dependent categories (BT-3c, 74.8%; BT-2, 69.2%; BT-4, 69.3%; BT-3b, 57.1%). The BT-4 positive predictive value was 92.9%. These results support further evaluation of this system as a clinical decision-support tool, with local open-weight inference preserving data privacy.

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate whether increasing agentic architectural complexity via self-reflection or multiagent design improves clinical code status extraction (Do Not Resuscitate [DNR], Do Not Intubate [DNI], Comfort Measures Only [CMO]) across open-source large language models (LLMs) of varying capabilities. We conducted a controlled cross-model comparison evaluating 3 architectures: (1) single extractor agent, (2) single agent with self-reflection, and (3) sequential multiagent extractor-reviewer system. Four open-source LLMs (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, MedGemma-27B-IT, Qwen3.5-27B) were evaluated on 1000 Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV-Note discharge summaries. Ground truth labels were established through a physician-AI dual review with adjudication (Cohen's κ = 0.98-0.99). Models were evaluated on accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Cohen's κ, token consumption, and processing latency. McNemar's test was used for paired comparisons. For capable larger models (GPT-OSS-20B, MedGemma-27B-IT, Qwen3.5-27B), single-agent architectures achieved comparable or superior performance for explicit code status (DNR, DNI) relative to complex systems, whereas multiagent review doubled token consumption and latency without accuracy gains. Reflective self-review significantly impaired MedGemma-27B-IT on DNI extraction (P = .047). For the smaller DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, multiagent review provided statistically significant corrective benefits for DNR (P = .017) and CMO (P < .001), demonstrating a capability-threshold effect, though performance remained below clinically acceptable levels. Architectural complexity does not enhance extraction performance for capable LLMs, and reflective self-review may cause conservative overcorrection. Multiagent verification value is inversely related to model capability. Single-agent LLMs provide optimal accuracy and efficiency for explicit clinical extraction in capable models. Agentic complexity must be matched to both task characteristics and model capability rather than adopted by default.
items.zh_abstract: ［Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA］评估通过自我反思或多智能体设计增加智能体架构复杂性，是否能在能力各异的开源大语言模型（LLMs）中改善临床抢救状态（code status）提取（不进行复苏 [DNR]、不进行插管 [DNI]、仅采取舒适措施 [CMO]）。我们进行了一项受控的跨模型比较，评估3种架构：(1) 单一提取智能体；(2) 具备自我反思的单一智能体；(3) 顺序式多智能体提取器-审核器系统。在1,000份Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV-Note出院小结上评估了四个开源LLM（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、MedGemma-27B-IT、Qwen3.5-27B）。真实标签通过医师-AI双重审核并裁决建立（Cohen's κ = 0.98-0.99）。模型按准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、Cohen's κ、token消耗和处理延迟进行评估。采用McNemar检验进行配对比较。对于能力较强的大型模型（GPT-OSS-20B、MedGemma-27B-IT、Qwen3.5-27B），单智能体架构在明确的抢救状态（DNR、DNI）方面相对于复杂系统达到相当或更优的性能，而多智能体审核使token消耗和延迟翻倍，却没有准确率提升。反思性自我审核显著损害了MedGemma-27B-IT在DNI提取上的表现（P = .047）。对于较小的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B，多智能体审核对DNR（P = .017）和CMO（P < .001）提供了统计学显著的纠正获益，显示出能力阈值效应，尽管性能仍低于临床可接受水平。架构复杂性并不会提升有能力LLM的提取性能，且反思性自我审核可能导致保守性过度纠正。多智能体验证的价值与模型能力呈负相关。在能力较强的模型中，单智能体LLM为明确的临床提取提供最佳准确性和效率。智能体复杂性必须与任务特征和模型能力相匹配，而不是默认采用。

items.title: A language model framework for sequence modeling of audit logs to characterize clinician-electronic health record interactions.
items.source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
items.zh_title: 用语言模型对EHR审计日志序列建模
items.summary: 基于2.95亿条住院EHR审计日志微调Llama-3-8B，建模临床医生与电子病历的交互流程序列。
items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Electronic health record (EHR) audit logs capture clinician-EHR interaction patterns, but most audit log research relies on aggregated measures (eg, total time). We investigated how audit logs could be modeled using large language model (LLM) architectures to learn underlying workflow sequences during clinician-EHR interactions. Using >295 million EHR-based audit log actions from inpatient settings spanning 2019 to 2024, we fine-tuned Llama-3-8B under 2 encodings: (1) symbolic (field-based) tokens and (2) semantic (word-based) natural language-based audit log action descriptions. A first-order Markov model, using only the immediate prior action, served as a baseline minimal context comparator. Model representation was assessed using next-action prediction accuracy in an early-period test set and 2 temporally distinct out-of-sample (OOS) periods. In the early-period test set, the word-based LLM achieved the highest accuracy (0.7473; 95% CI, 0.7468-0.7478) compared to the field-based LLM (0.3464; 95% CI, 0.3456-0.3472) and Markov baseline (0.4230; 95% CI, 0.4223-0.4236). The word-based approach retained a substantial performance advantage over the Markov baseline across the OOS periods, although accuracy declined over time (word-based LLM vs Markov accuracy, OOS-1: 0.6555 vs 0.3139, OOS-2: 0.6286 vs 0.2720). Word-based LLM relying on audit log action descriptions yielded the highest next-action prediction accuracy and demonstrated relative robustness to temporal drift, suggesting that longer sequential context and word-based action descriptions may improve audit log-based sequence modeling. These findings support the development of natural language-based LLM models for audit log research for task identification, workflow characterization, and safety-focused analyses of clinician-EHR interaction patterns.

items.zh_abstract: 《Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA》电子健康记录（EHR）审计日志可捕捉临床医生与EHR的交互模式，但大多数审计日志研究依赖汇总指标（例如总时间）。我们研究了如何使用大语言模型（LLM）架构对审计日志进行建模，以学习临床医生与EHR交互过程中潜在的工作流程序列。利用2019年至2024年间来自住院环境的超过2.95亿条基于EHR的审计日志操作，我们在2种编码下微调Llama-3-8B：（1）符号（基于字段）token和（2）语义（基于词）的自然语言审计日志操作描述。仅使用紧邻前一操作的一阶马尔可夫模型作为基线最小上下文比较器。模型表征通过早期测试集和2个时间上不同的样本外（OOS）时期中的下一操作预测准确率进行评估。在早期测试集中，基于词的LLM取得了最高准确率（0.7473；95% CI，0.7468-0.7478），而基于字段的LLM为（0.3464；95% CI，0.3456-0.3472），马尔可夫基线为（0.4230；95% CI，0.4223-0.4236）。在各OOS时期，基于词的方法相对于马尔可夫基线保持了显著性能优势，尽管准确率随时间下降（基于词的LLM vs 马尔可夫准确率，OOS-1：0.6555 vs 0.3139，OOS-2：0.6286 vs 0.2720）。依赖审计日志操作描述的基于词的LLM产生了最高的下一操作预测准确率，并表现出对时间漂移的相对稳健性，提示较长的序列上下文和基于词的操作描述可能改善基于审计日志的序列建模。这些发现支持开发基于自然语言的LLM模型用于审计日志研究，以进行任务识别、工作流程刻画以及针对临床医生与EHR交互模式的安全性分析。

items.title: Transparency features alone are insufficient for trust calibration in artificial intelligence diagnostic support.
items.source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
items.zh_title: 透明度功能不足以校准临床医生对AI诊断的信任
items.summary: JAMIA随机对照实验纳入220名临床医生，比较无透明度、数值置信度与叙述性解释三种条件，均未显著影响信任或可信度感知。
items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Clinician trust in artificial intelligence (AI) is a frequently cited barrier to adoption, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how transparency features influence trust. This study aimed to address this evidence gap. We conducted a randomized controlled experiment in which 220 clinicians were randomized to 1 of 3 conditions: no transparency (control), numeric confidence scores, or narrative explanations with citations, using simulated AI diagnostic assistance across clinical case vignettes. Transparency did not influence tool-specific trust [F(2, 214) = 0.38, P = .68], global trust [F(2, 217) = 0.13, P = .88], or perceived information credibility [F(2, 210) = 0.42, P = .66]. Confidence increased following any AI assistance (+6.7%), but narrative explanations were associated with greater change in confidence compared with both control (P = .024) and numeric confidence (P = .0051). Participants changed or refined diagnoses after reviewing AI output 45.8% (SD 23.4%) of the time, with participants in the control group demonstrating higher levels of behavioral influence than transparency conditions (P = .0006). Trust, confidence, and behavioral influence represent distinct constructs and are impacted differently by transparency methods. The difference in these contributions to clinician-AI partnerships should be considered when designing for safe trust calibration, with particular consideration for the dissociation between trust and confidence. These findings suggest common interface transparency features alone failed to produce a detectable, meaningful shift in clinician trust in AI assistance and that changes may instead alter behavioral influence and confidence without a corresponding change in trust.

items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 临床医生对人工智能（AI）的信任是常被提及的采用障碍，然而关于透明度特征如何影响信任的实证证据有限。本研究旨在填补这一证据空白。我们开展了一项随机对照实验，将 220 名临床医生随机分配到 3 种条件中的 1 种：无透明度（对照）、数字置信度评分，或带有引用的叙述性解释，并在临床病例情景中使用模拟 AI 诊断辅助。透明度未影响工具特定信任 [F(2, 214) = 0.38, P = .68]、总体信任 [F(2, 217) = 0.13, P = .88] 或感知信息可信度 [F(2, 210) = 0.42, P = .66]。在任何 AI 辅助后置信度均增加（+6.7%），但与对照（P = .024）和数字置信度（P = .0051）相比，叙述性解释与更大的置信度变化相关。参与者在查看 AI 输出后改变或细化诊断的比例为 45.8%（SD 23.4%），其中对照组参与者表现出比透明度条件更高的行为影响水平（P = .0006）。信任、置信度和行为影响代表不同的构念，并受到透明度方法的不同影响。在设计安全的信任校准时应考虑这些对临床医生-AI 伙伴关系的贡献差异，尤其要考虑信任与置信度之间的分离。这些发现表明，仅常见的界面透明度特征未能对临床医生对 AI 辅助的信任产生可检测的、有意义的转变，并且这些变化可能反而改变行为影响和置信度，而没有相应的信任变化。

items.abstract: Health systems are deploying clinical artificial intelligence (AI) faster than they can govern it, and existing frameworks emphasize risk oversight over operational learning and scale. The Collaborative Technology Adoption for Care Transformation (C-TACT) framework, developed at Southern California Permanente Medical Group (SCPMG), organizes governance across three pillars (People, Process, Technology) and four lifecycle stages (Vendor Evaluation, Pilot, Scale, Maintenance), each operationalized through a domain-weighted scorecard. Scale and Maintenance scorecards incorporate business and operational execution as weighted domains, with Analytic Hierarchy Process methods (consistency ratio 0.0037). In an illustrative, retrospective application, the Pilot Score Card separated two published SCPMG AI deployments and four anonymized comparators (47.0–53.5) by approximately thirty points across three weighting schemes. This separation illustrates how the framework behaves in this comparison. It is not evidence of validated discriminative performance, because the comparator scores were reconstructed retrospectively and were not scored under blinded conditions. C-TACT is presented here as a governance framework and a methodological demonstration. Prospective, blinded validation is needed to establish its discriminative and predictive performance under real-world conditions.
items.zh_abstract: 卫生系统部署临床人工智能（AI）的速度快于其治理能力，现有框架更强调风险监督，而非运营学习与规模化。协作技术采纳促进照护转型（Collaborative Technology Adoption for Care Transformation，C-TACT）框架由南加州永久医疗集团（Southern California Permanente Medical Group，SCPMG）开发，将治理组织为三大支柱（人员、流程、技术）和四个生命周期阶段（供应商评估、试点、规模化、维护），每个阶段均通过领域加权评分卡进行操作化。规模化与维护评分卡将业务与运营执行作为加权领域纳入，采用层次分析法（Analytic Hierarchy Process）方法（一致性比率 0.0037）。在一项示例性的回顾性应用中，试点评分卡在三种权重方案下将两个已发表的 SCPMG AI 部署与四个匿名对照（47.0–53.5）区分开，差距约三十分。这种区分说明了该框架在此比较中的表现方式。它并非经过验证的判别性能证据，因为对照评分是回顾性重建的，且并非在盲法条件下评分。本文仅将 C-TACT 作为治理框架和方法学示范进行展示。需要前瞻性、盲法验证，以确立其在真实世界条件下的判别与预测性能。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] This retrospective cohort study evaluated the effect of an artificial intelligence (AI) scribe on patient instructions documentation in ambulatory internal medicine settings. We analyzed 391 061 adult encounters at a single medical center from December 2023 to July 2025. A difference-in-differences analysis estimated the relationship of AI scribe availability with patient instructions documentation frequency. Mixed-effects logistic regression estimated the association between encounter-level AI scribe utilization and documentation, adjusted for patient, clinician, and encounter characteristics. Length and readability were compared across instructions created by AI alone, clinicians assisted by AI, and clinicians alone. Character-level edit distances between AI drafts and final documentation were calculated. AI scribe availability was associated with a 10.5 percentage-point increase in patient instructions documentation frequency (P = .018), and encounter-level AI use was associated with higher odds of documentation (aOR 4.32; 95% CI, 4.14-4.50). AI instructions were longer than clinician-authored content (median 1994 vs 482 characters) and scored higher on 3 text-complexity indices (all P < .001). Clinician editing of AI content increased length without meaningfully reducing complexity. AI drafts and final documentation differed substantially, with a median character-level edit distance of 39.7%. AI scribe availability was associated with increased patient instructions documentation. However, AI-generated instructions were longer and scored as more linguistically complex than clinician-authored instructions, and clinician editing did not close this gap. Ambient AI scribes can improve availability but may increase complexity of patient instructions. Research into downstream effects including patient comprehension and satisfaction is warranted.
items.zh_abstract: [《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》] 这项回顾性队列研究评估了人工智能（AI）记录员（AI scribe）对门诊内科环境中患者指导文书记录的影响。我们分析了2023年12月至2025年7月期间单一医疗中心的391 061次成人就诊。双重差分分析估计了AI记录员可用性与患者指导文书记录频率之间的关系。混合效应逻辑回归估计了就诊层面AI记录员使用与文书记录之间的关联，并调整了患者、临床医生和就诊特征。比较了仅由AI创建、临床医生在AI辅助下创建以及仅由临床医生创建的指导文书在长度和可读性上的差异。计算了AI草稿与最终文书之间的字符级编辑距离。AI记录员可用性与患者指导文书记录频率增加10.5个百分点相关（P = .018），就诊层面AI使用与更高的文书记录几率相关（aOR 4.32；95% CI，4.14-4.50）。AI指导文书比临床医生撰写的内容更长（中位数1994个字符 vs 482个字符），并且在3项文本复杂度指数上得分更高（均P < .001）。临床医生对AI内容的编辑增加了长度，但未显著降低复杂度。AI草稿与最终文书差异很大，字符级编辑距离中位数为39.7%。AI记录员可用性与患者指导文书记录增加相关。然而，AI生成的指导文书比临床医生撰写的指导文书更长，且在语言上被评为更复杂，临床医生的编辑并未缩小这一差距。环境AI记录员可以提高可用性，但可能增加患者指导文书的复杂度。有必要研究下游影响，包括患者理解和满意度。

items.abstract: Standardized patients (SPs) are central to clinical communication training but remain constrained by cost, scalability, and reliance on trained actors. We present AI standardized patients (AI-SPs), large language model–driven patient simulators built on a three-layer information architecture that adaptively modulates information disclosure according to learner skill. In Phase 1, blinded expert assessment of 350 simulated consultations generated by five frontier LLMs showed that, under a common architecture, learner skill level accounted for more of the observed performance variation than model choice ( η 2 = 0.31 vs. 0.06); whether this reflects the architecture itself cannot be determined without comparing models with and without it. In Phase 1b, analysis of 155 live student consultations identified systematic failures to elicit safety-critical information, enabling automated curriculum diagnostics without expert observation. In a Phase 2 three-arm pilot randomized study ( n = 58), OSCE performance gains with AI-SP training did not differ significantly from those with human SP training; the trial was designed to estimate effect sizes for a future confirmatory study, not to demonstrate equivalence. Self-efficacy gains were numerically largest with AI-SP training, but this exploratory difference did not survive correction for multiple comparisons. These findings suggest that architecture-driven AI-SPs could provide a scalable, model-portable approach to clinical communication training.
items.zh_abstract: 标准化病人（SP）是临床沟通培训的核心，但仍受成本、可扩展性和对受过训练演员的依赖所限制。我们提出AI标准化病人（AI-SP），即由大语言模型驱动的患者模拟器，其建立在三层信息架构之上，可根据学习者技能自适应调节信息披露。在第一阶段，对五个前沿LLM生成的350次模拟咨询进行盲法专家评估显示，在共同架构下，学习者技能水平比模型选择解释了更多观察到的表现变异（η² = 0.31 vs. 0.06）；若不比较有无该架构的模型，则无法确定这是否反映架构本身。在第一阶段b，对155次真实学生咨询的分析识别出未能引出安全关键信息的系统性失败，从而能够在无专家观察的情况下实现自动化课程诊断。在一项第二阶段三臂试点随机研究（n = 58）中，AI-SP培训的OSCE表现提升与人类SP培训无显著差异；该试验旨在为未来确证性研究估计效应量，而非证明等效性。AI-SP培训的自我效能提升在数值上最大，但这一探索性差异未通过多重比较校正。这些发现表明，架构驱动的AI-SP可为临床沟通培训提供一种可扩展、模型可移植的方法。

items.abstract: [Journal of pain and symptom management] This article describes integration of a large language model (LLM) into the electronic health record (EHR) to identify unstructured goals-of-care (GOC) documentation or discrete data entry. To determine whether a prompt-engineered LLM reliably detects GOC documentation in clinical notes comparable to human experts and can display this evaluation to clinicians in real time. An interdisciplinary team of palliative care experts created an adjudicated reference standard, which was used to evaluate LLM models in detecting GOC documentation. Given this, the best-fit model (GPT-4o) was then integrated with the EHR for a six-month pilot at four hospitals, then released enterprise-wide. GPT-4o achieved the best performance (specificity 0.95, recall 0.74, precision 0.78). Manual audit on AI-flagged notes (n=325) confirmed substantial expert agreement (86%). In subgroup analyses, there was no statistically significant differences across race, sex, or age (specificity range 0.91-1; all p-values > 0.05). At enterprise scale, the model identified 37,000 patients with GOC documentation within approximately two months. In comparison to those without, patients with AI-flagged GOC documentation had higher acuity rates (ICU stay ≥5 days: 30.2% vs 8.2%; in-hospital mortality: 14.9% vs 0.6%; hospice discharge: 10.5% vs 0.4%). Code status changes were also significantly more frequent (29.3% vs 9.9%; p<0.05). Our initiative met the original objectives by providing a financially sustainable EHR optimization that converts unstructured, high-value GOC narratives into real-time discoverable and trackable documentation. Detecting and displaying these conversations is crucial, increasing clinical situational awareness while reducing documentation burden, leading to enhanced goal-concordant care.
items.zh_abstract: 【Journal of pain and symptom management】本文描述将大语言模型（large language model，LLM）整合到电子健康记录（electronic health record，EHR）中，以识别非结构化的目标照护（goals-of-care，GOC）文档或离散数据录入。旨在确定经过提示工程（prompt-engineered）的LLM能否可靠地检测临床笔记中的GOC文档，性能可与人类专家相比，并能实时向临床医生显示该评估。一个跨学科姑息治疗专家团队创建了裁定参考标准，用于评估LLM模型检测GOC文档的表现。据此，最佳拟合模型（GPT-4o）随后与EHR整合，在四家医院进行为期六个月的试点，然后在全企业范围发布。GPT-4o取得最佳性能（特异度0.95，召回率0.74，精确率0.78）。对AI标记笔记（n=325）的人工审核确认与专家高度一致（86%）。在亚组分析中，种族、性别或年龄之间无统计学显著差异（特异度范围0.91-1；所有p值> 0.05）。在企业规模上，该模型在约两个月内识别出37,000名有GOC文档的患者。与没有AI标记GOC文档的患者相比，有AI标记GOC文档的患者具有更高的重症率（ICU停留≥5天：30.2% vs 8.2%；院内死亡率：14.9% vs 0.6%；临终关怀出院：10.5% vs 0.4%）。复苏状态（code status）变更也显著更频繁（29.3% vs 9.9%；p<0.05）。我们的计划通过提供财务可持续的EHR优化实现了最初目标，该优化将非结构化、高价值的GOC叙述转化为实时可发现和可追踪的文档。检测并显示这些对话至关重要，可提高临床情境意识，同时减少文档负担，从而促进增强的目标一致照护。

items.abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised convolutional neural network methods have greatly improved the performance of low-dose computed tomography (CT) denoising. However, they require paired noisy-clean training data, which is difficult to obtain in practice. Some classic self-supervised denoising methods rely on the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise, making them ineffective for correlated noise in low-dose CT (LDCT) images. Considering the high similarity and weaker noise correlation between adjacent CT slices, several recently proposed self-supervised methods use adjacent LDCT slices for training. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to effectively account for the non-rigid mis-alignment between slices caused by anatomical variation, hindering them from satisfying the equal-mean condition required by the classic Noise2Noise framework. In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices, and then applies correction to the denoiser's outputs to better satisfy the equal-mean condition. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy-clean images. We further find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose cone-beam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. To the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective image-domain self-supervised method for low-dose CBCT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms existing image-domain self-supervised methods, offering broader applicability and higher practical value.

items.zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 随着深度学习的快速发展，监督式卷积神经网络方法已大幅提升低剂量计算机断层扫描（CT）去噪的性能。然而，这些方法需要配对的噪声-干净训练数据，而这在实际中难以获得。一些经典自监督去噪方法依赖于逐像素独立噪声的假设，使其对低剂量CT（LDCT）图像中的相关噪声无效。考虑到相邻CT层面之间的高度相似性和较弱噪声相关性，近期提出的若干自监督方法使用相邻LDCT层面进行训练。然而，这些方法未能有效考虑由解剖变异引起的层面间非刚性错位，阻碍其满足经典Noise2Noise框架所要求的等均值条件。本文提出Noise2Match，一种基于自适应层面间匹配的自监督LDCT去噪方法。Noise2Match引入层面间匹配网络来建模相邻层面之间的标签转移过程，然后对去噪器输出施加校正，以更好地满足等均值条件。我们从理论上证明，在理想化条件下，使用相邻LDCT层面训练Noise2Match等效于使用配对噪声-干净图像进行监督训练。我们进一步发现，Noise2Match也能有效执行低剂量锥形束CT（CBCT）去噪，这可能归因于其减少层面间噪声相关性的校正操作。据我们所知，Noise2Match是首个用于低剂量CBCT的有效图像域自监督方法。大量实验表明，Noise2Match优于现有图像域自监督方法，具有更广泛的适用性和更高的实用价值。

items.abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The exponential growth of large vision-language models (VLMs) has created significant opportunities for advancing multimodal artificial intelligence in specialized domains such as ophthalmology. However, progress in ophthalmic VLMs remains limited, primarily due to the lack of large-scale, high-quality image-text pairs. Moreover, existing VLMs frequently generate hallucinations, leading to uncertainty and unreliability that are unacceptable in clinical practice. To address the data scarcity issue, we introduce IT-Retinal, a dedicated ophthalmic Vision Question Answering (VQA) dataset that providesmultigranularity tasks and high-quality long-form textual content in image-text pairs. To mitigate hallucinations, we propose EyeGraph, a framework for ophthalmic VLMs that consists of two training stages, targeted pre-training and fine-tuning, and one inference stage that integrates Graph of Thought (GoT) and Think on Graph (ToG) reasoning, referred to as G2T. This design enables EyeGraph to incorporate structured external knowledge, constrain the output space, and produce more clinically consistent results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EyeGraph achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven clinically relevant benchmarks, spanning disease diagnosis, structural detection and localization, and report generation. Notably, the proposed G2T reasoning module consistently improves the factual consistency and reliability of ophthalmic report generation. All source code, along with an interactive demo, is publicly available at: https://github.com/ZardCAI/EyeGraph.

items.zh_abstract: [IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging] 大型视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）的指数级增长为在眼科等专业领域推进多模态人工智能创造了重要机遇。然而，眼科VLMs的进展仍然有限，主要原因是缺乏大规模、高质量的图像-文本对。此外，现有VLMs经常产生幻觉，导致临床实践中不可接受的不确定性和不可靠性。为解决数据稀缺问题，我们引入IT-Retinal，这是一个专门的眼科视觉问答（Vision Question Answering, VQA）数据集，在图像-文本对中提供多粒度任务和高质量长文本内容。为减轻幻觉，我们提出EyeGraph，这是一个用于眼科VLMs的框架，包含两个训练阶段——有针对性的预训练和微调——以及一个推理阶段，该推理阶段整合了思维图（Graph of Thought, GoT）和图上思考（Think on Graph, ToG）推理，称为G2T。这一设计使EyeGraph能够纳入结构化外部知识、约束输出空间，并产生更具临床一致性的结果。大量实验表明，EyeGraph在七个临床相关基准上达到最先进性能，涵盖疾病诊断、结构检测与定位以及报告生成。值得注意的是，所提出的G2T推理模块持续提高了眼科报告生成的事实一致性和可靠性。所有源代码以及交互式演示均公开可用，地址为：https://github.com/ZardCAI/EyeGraph。

items.abstract: [Computational and structural biotechnology journal] Bladder cancer ranks as the 10th most common malignancy worldwide. Advances in technology are continuously reshaping its diagnosis, treatment selection, and prognosis assessment. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated marked potential in transforming bladder cancer care. By integrating and analyzing multi-source data, AI enhances the precision and efficiency of disease management. This review comprehensively examines the current applications of AI across various domains, including radiographic imaging analysis, pathological diagnosis, cystoscopic image processing, molecular subtyping, drug development, organoid research, prognostic modeling, and medical device innovation. It highlights the advantages of AI over conventional methods, outlines model development strategies, and summarizes commonly employed algorithms. Furthermore, we discuss the key challenges in translating AI tools into real-world clinical practice. This narrative review aims to inform the future development of AI-driven digital health systems, ultimately contributing to the realization of precision medicine and personalized management for bladder cancer patients.
items.zh_abstract: [《计算与结构生物技术杂志》] 膀胱癌是全球第10大常见恶性肿瘤。技术进步正在持续重塑其诊断、治疗选择和预后评估。近年来，人工智能（AI）在改变膀胱癌诊疗方面展现出显著潜力。通过整合和分析多源数据，AI提高了疾病管理的精准性和效率。本综述全面审视了AI在多个领域的当前应用，包括放射影像分析、病理诊断、膀胱镜图像处理、分子分型、药物研发、类器官研究、预后建模和医疗器械创新。文章强调了AI相对于传统方法的优势，概述了模型开发策略，并总结了常用算法。此外，我们讨论了将AI工具转化为真实世界临床实践中的关键挑战。这篇叙述性综述旨在为AI驱动的数字健康系统的未来发展提供信息，最终有助于实现膀胱癌患者的精准医学和个性化管理。

items.abstract: [Journal of neuro-oncology] Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) are critical tools for measuring how patients experience their illness and treatment. Neuropsychiatric symptoms, headaches, seizures, and neurological deficits evolve over time and impact quality of life. In this narrative review, we summarize current literature on PROs in neuro-oncology, extant artificial intelligence (AI) tools for PRO analysis, considerations for real-world application, and ethical implications. We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Google Scholar for English-language articles published from January 2015 through April 2026, supplemented by reference-list reviews. Four themes were agreed upon, and authors were assigned to each theme. Authors conducted a literature review, selected articles, and synthesized the information under each of these themes. An initial 78 articles were narrowed down to 53 confirming eligibility if they reported PRO or symptom data in people with brain tumors or computational/AI methods were applied to PRO or symptom monitoring in oncology. Article selection was verified by two senior authors (L.V.Y, A.S.). Older, foundational studies were retained where they remain the primary evidence. The growing volume and complexity of PRO data present challenges for traditional analysis methods. Integrating AI, including machine learning (ML) and large language models (LLMs), may help model longitudinal symptom trajectories to predict deterioration, extract symptoms from free-text clinical notes, and embed outputs in clinical decision support tools. Autonomy, informed consent, data security, bias, access, transparency and accountability should be considered. Successful translation will require interpretable, electronic health record-integrated, bias-mitigating tools that allow for actionable insights and preserve patient consent, privacy, and autonomy in this highly vulnerable population. items.zh_abstract: [Journal of Neuro-Oncology] 患者报告结局（patient-reported outcomes, PROs）是衡量患者如何体验其疾病和治疗的关键工具。神经精神症状、头痛、癫痫发作和神经功能缺损随时间演变并影响生活质量。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们总结了当前关于神经肿瘤学中PROs的文献、用于PRO分析的现有AI工具、真实世界应用的考虑以及伦理影响。我们检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase和Google Scholar，纳入2015年1月至2026年4月发表的英文文章，并辅以参考文献列表审查。确定了四个主题，并为每个主题分配了作者。作者对每个主题进行了文献综述、筛选文章并综合信息。最初78篇文章缩小至53篇，若报告了脑肿瘤患者的PRO或症状数据，或计算/AI方法应用于肿瘤学中的PRO或症状监测，则确认符合纳入标准。文章选择由两位资深作者（L.V.Y, A.S.）核实。较早期的奠基性研究若仍是主要证据则予以保留。PRO数据数量和复杂性的不断增长给传统分析方法带来挑战。整合AI，包括机器学习（machine learning, ML）和大语言模型（large language models, LLMs），可能有助于建模纵向症状轨迹以预测恶化、从自由文本临床记录中提取症状，并将输出嵌入临床决策支持工具。应考虑自主性、知情同意、数据安全、偏倚、可及性、透明度和问责制。成功转化将需要可解释、整合电子健康记录、减轻偏倚的工具，这些工具能够提供可操作的见解，并在这一高度脆弱人群中维护患者同意、隐私和自主性。不适用。

items.abstract: Pathological examination stands as the cornerstone in cancer diagnosis, impacting millions worldwide annually. With the shortage of pathologists globally, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged rapidly to automate the diagnostics process. However, conventional AI models require substantial labeled data for each disease, posing huge challenges in scalability and practicality. Therefore, we introduce PRET (pan-cancer recognition without examples training), a few-shot system to achieve flexible, scalable, and effective cancer recognition across diverse organs, hospitals and tasks without training.
